title: 36 Hours in Detroit
abstract: The city that brought us automobiles and Motown has seen tough times. But Detroit always rises again.

title: 36 Hours in East London
abstract: Now a hub for the trend-conscious set, East London hasn’t lost its industrial roots and vibrant immigrant communities.

title: 36 Hours on the Outer Banks, N.C.
abstract: A series of barrier islands along North Carolina’s coast, the Outer Banks offer hang gliding, wild horse tours and fresh seafood.

title: 36 Hours in Istanbul
abstract: In Istanbul, a center of culture, commerce and power for more than 2,000 years, the past never feels distant. Yet contemporary culture thrives here.
